title: Use Cases
description: A numbered switcher: pick the reader you are, and the picture changes with the story.
a11y: Each case is a button with aria-expanded that controls its scene. Up/Down move focus between cases (Home/End jump), and Enter or Space opens one; only the open case's scene is shown. Each section switches independently. The buttons still contain their headings and lists, which screen readers read as one long button name; splitting them is follow-up work. Screen-reader output is not yet verified by hand.
